info.title: SEE API Endpoints
info.description: Compact JSON catalog of endpoints, params, auth requirements and request/response schemas for the frontend

servers.description: Search businesses for dropdowns and selectors.

endpoints.description: Search public events. Accepts geo, text, and address hints; DB-first then discovery fallback.

queryParams.name: city
queryParams.note: address hint - will geocode if lat/lon missing

queryParams.name: state
queryParams.note: address hint - will geocode if lat/lon missing

queryParams.name: venue
queryParams.note: address hint - will geocode if lat/lon missing

queryParams.name: attrsAll
queryParams.note: comma-separated venue attribute ids that must all match

queryParams.name: attrsAny
queryParams.note: comma-separated venue attribute ids where any match

endpoints.description: List available curated playlists (Featured, Weekend, etc.).
Fetch a single playlist and its events. Supports optional geo and audience overrides to personalize variants.
Submit a claim request so the signed-in user can manage a venue on behalf of a business.
Log an anonymous or signed-in user interaction (currently views) for venue analytics.
Advanced search with geo and text branches. DB-first, discovery fallback, re-query and return discovered results.

queryParams.name: status
queryParams.note: comma-separated; default active,planning; use attending to pull the signed-in user's RSVPs

200.description: SearchResults containing items (EventDto[]), count, discovered flag

endpoints.description: Record a client-side interaction (view, click, save, share, ticket-click, map-open) for analytics and ranking.

List uploaded event media assets used by the page builder (images, files).

Save favorite categories used for discovery chips.
